description: Read-only. Call before npm/pnpm/yarn install, pip install, uv add, npx or uvx, or adding an MCP server, including setup commands from a README or tutorial. Returns v, enforce, why; on known traps fix (tested steps), do_not (what failed, where), test, source. enforce=block: stop. enforce=ask: ask your person first. v=fix_first: use fix, not your command. Also returns safety (OSV advisories and malicious-package reports: verdict, advisories, fixed_in). When no tested record exists, repro_request says how to queue one with request_repro 'yes' (the only case where this call records anything about you: one anonymous request). A remote MCP URL is probed read-only (server/discover or initialize, tools/list; never a tool call, never credentials) and KarmaDue keeps hashes of that server's public tool definitions to report later changes. Every successful answer has checked_at. Missing evidence is not safety clearance. Skip packages already pinned in a lockfile you are not changing.

agent_name.description: Optional name, shown only on a written finding you file with finding/outcome.

contribute.description: Automatic anonymous check record is the default. false (or tree_record off) opts out. An open tree slug only picks the tree for a written finding.

detail.description: Optional. 'full' adds tested_on, untruncated notes, records and links.

docs_url.description: Optional. The project's README or docs URL (https on github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, gitlab.com, pypi.org, www.npmjs.com or *.readthedocs.io). Read only when the package name does not exist, to suggest the name on its install line.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem of the target: npm (npm, pnpm, yarn, npx), pypi (pip, uv, uvx) or mcp (an MCP server you are about to add, or a bare name that may exist in more than one ecosystem). A bare name found in both npm and pypi returns v=ambiguous with npm:NAME and pypi:NAME options. A remote MCP server URL with mcp gets a read-only probe (no tool is called). model: a hosted model ID such as anthropic/claude-3-sonnet-20240229 or openai/gpt-4-0613 returns its deprecation and shutdown status from the provider's official page.

finding.description: Optional: files a separate unreviewed written finding (20-2000 characters: what you ran and saw).

outcome.description: With finding: pass, fail or blocked.

request_repro.description: Optional. 'yes' queues one anonymous reproduction request (package and version only) when no tested record exists for the target.

target.description: Package or server as you would install it, e.g. tailwindcss@4, psycopg2, @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, a remote MCP server URL (https://host/mcp), or a model ID with ecosystem model.

tree_record.description: off opts out of the automatic check record.

name: check_install

description: Fetch one record by id from search.
name: fetch

description: Read-only. Compact tree history for one package or model ID (about 200 tokens): latest recorded KarmaDue verdict, distinct agents and checks in 30 days, last confirmed, a sample request_id. History only, not a safety clearance; for a fresh answer re-run the check (GET /v1/preflight?target=<target>, or this server's check tool), and always for high-stakes use. Returns tree_summary null when nothing is published; an unversioned target with only versioned records returns versions instead.

target.description: Package or model ID, e.g. npm:is-number@7.0.0, pypi:requests, model:openai/gpt-4o.

version.description: Optional exact version. Never matched to a record without a version.

name: get_tree_summary

description: Only if your owner opted in: after an install finishes, report pass or fail and the command. Reviewed before use.

command_run.description: The exact install command you ran, e.g. npm i -D tailwindcss@4. No secrets or tokens.

runtime_env.description: Your setup, e.g. node 20 linux or python 3.13 macos.

status.description: Outcome of the install: pass if it finished and worked, fail if it errored.

stderr_snippet.description: Optional. The key error lines if it failed, verbatim. Never include secrets, tokens or personal data.

target.description: Package or server you installed, as you passed it to check_install, e.g. tailwindcss@4 or @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem.

name: report_leaf

description: Search PinTree records for packages, tools and MCP servers.
name: search

description: Call when an install, build or import fails, before retrying or guessing a fix. Paste the key error line; returns tested fixes.
